# Basic — Ad SCFT

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “AdS/CFT correspondence”).

claims.name: ads_cft_correspondence_deduced_ads
claims.statement: The $AdS_2/CFT$ correspondence can be deduced from the $AdS_3/CFT$.

sources.title: Two Dimensional Anti-de Sitter Space and Discrete Light Cone Quantization

claims.name: kerr_cft_correspondence_generalizes_kerrnewmanadsds
claims.statement: The Kerr/CFT correspondence generalizes to the Kerr-Newman-AdS-dS/CFT correspondence in four dimensions.

sources.title: CFT Duals for Extreme Black Holes

claims.name: cft_operators_match_kk_states
claims.statement: CFT operators match KK states in the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Supergravity Predictions on Conformal Field Theories

claims.name: via_ads_cft_correspondence_cft
claims.statement: Via the AdS/CFT correspondence, CFT Mellin amplitudes correspond to scattering in AdS$_{d+1}$.

sources.title: Froissart bound for/from CFT Mellin amplitudes

claims.name: ads_singletons_clarify_role_ads
claims.statement: AdS singletons clarify the role in the AdS/CFT correspondence

claims.name: ads_qcd_application_ads_cft
claims.statement: AdS/QCD is an application of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

claims.name: calculation_uses_ads_cft_correspondence
claims.statement: The calculation uses the AdS/CFT correspondence.

claims.name: ads_cft_correspondence_follows_symmetry
claims.statement: AdS/CFT correspondence follows from this symmetry.

sources.title: AdS/CFT Correspondence as a Consequence of Scale Invariance

claims.name: model_uses_ads_cft_correspondence
claims.statement: The model uses the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Current-driven tricritical point in large-$N_{c}$ gauge theory

claims.name: argument_uses_ads_cft_correspondence
claims.statement: The argument uses the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Scale Invariance and the AdS/CFT Correspondence

claims.name: nonrelativistic_ads_cft_correspondence_requires
claims.statement: The non-relativistic AdS/CFT correspondence requires a strongly interacting CFT.

sources.title: Shear Viscosity of a Non-Relativistic Conformal Gas in Two Dimensions

claims.name: ds_cft_correspondence_ads_cft
claims.statement: The dS/CFT correspondence and the AdS/CFT correspondence are strikingly similar in several respects despite key differences.

sources.title: Exploring the Similarities of the dS/CFT and Ads/CFT Correspondences

claims.name: ads_context_motivates_relevance_ads
claims.statement: The AdS$_4$ context motivates relevance to the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Black Holes in AdS4 from Very Special Geometry

claims.name: effective_action_cft_obtained_ads
claims.statement: The effective action of the CFT is obtained from AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Strongly Coupled CFT in FRW Universe from AdS/CFT Correspondence

claims.name: hamiltonian_formulation_ads_cft_correspondence
claims.statement: A Hamiltonian formulation of the $AdS_2/CFT_1$ correspondence is examined as a toy model for the Hamiltonian formalism of the $AdS/CFT$ correspondence.

sources.title: Comments On Hamiltonian Formalism Of $AdS/CFT$ correspondence

claims.name: cs_cft_correspondence_more_fundamental
claims.statement: The $CS_{2+1}/CFT_1$ correspondence is more fundamental than the conjectured $AdS_{2+1}/CFT_2$ correspondence.

sources.title: Symmetry Algebras in Chern-Simons Theories with Boundary: Canonical Approach

claims.name: kerr_cft_correspondence_follows_decoupling
claims.statement: The Kerr/CFT correspondence follows as a decoupling of the standard AdS/CFT correspondence applied to rotating black holes.

sources.title: Retarded Green's Function from Rotating AdS Black Holes: Emergent CFT$_2$ and Viscosity

claims.name: result_consistent_ads_cft_correspondence
claims.statement: The result is consistent with AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: On Large N Solution of ABJM Theory
